BatchUpdateNoticeStatus.title: Updates the status of message notification
BatchUpdateNoticeStatus.summary: Updates the notification status in batches

CancelCertificateForPackageRequest.title: CancelCertificateForPackageRequest
CancelCertificateForPackageRequest.summary: Revokes an issued certificate or cancels a pending certificate order and restores the quota.

CancelOrderRequest.title: CancelOrderRequest
CancelOrderRequest.summary: Cancels a certificate application order that is pending domain verification or under review.

CreateCertificateForPackageRequest.title: CreateCertificateForPackageRequest
CreateCertificateForPackageRequest.summary: Submits a certificate application by using a purchased certificate package quota.

CreateCertificateRequest.title: CreateCertificateRequest
CreateCertificateRequest.summary: Purchases, applies for, and issues a domain validated (DV) certificate by using extended certificate services.

CreateCertificateWithCsrRequest.title: CreateCertificateWithCsrRequest
CreateCertificateWithCsrRequest.summary: Purchases, applies for, and issues a domain validated (DV) certificate by using a custom certificate signing request (CSR) file.

CreateCsr.title: CreateCsr
CreateCsr.summary: Creates a certificate signing request (CSR) that contains information about an SSL certificate to apply for, such as the domain names and the certificate holder. You must provide a CSR when you submit a certificate application to a certificate authority (CA).

CreateDeploymentJob.title: CreateDeploymentJob
CreateDeploymentJob.summary: Creates a certificate deployment task to deploy an SSL certificate to one or more Alibaba Cloud services immediately or at a scheduled time.

CreateWHClientCertificate.title: CreateWHClientCertificate
CreateWHClientCertificate.summary: Issues a single client certificate from the general user certificate repository.

Decrypt.title: Decrypt
Decrypt.summary: Decrypts data that was encrypted by using a certificate in a certificate application repository.

DeleteCertificateRequest.title: DeleteCertificateRequest
DeleteCertificateRequest.summary: Deletes a failed domain validated (DV) certificate application order.

DeletePCACert.title: DeletePCACert
DeletePCACert.summary: Deletes a private certificate from a certificate application repository.

DeleteUserCertificate.title: Delete a certificate
DeleteUserCertificate.summary: Deletes an expired, revoked, or uploaded certificate.

DeleteWorkerResource.title: DeleteWorkerResource
DeleteWorkerResource.summary: Deletes a worker task from a certificate deployment task.

DescribeCertificateState.title: DescribeCertificateState
DescribeCertificateState.summary: Queries the status of a certificate application order, such as domain validation progress.

DescribeCloudResourceStatus.title: DescribeCloudResourceStatus
DescribeCloudResourceStatus.summary: Queries the number of cloud resources on which certificates were deployed by using a multi-cloud deployment task.

DescribeDeploymentJob.title: DescribeDeploymentJob
DescribeDeploymentJob.summary: Retrieves information about a certificate deployment task, including the task status, target resources, and certificates.

DescribeDeploymentJobStatus.title: DescribeDeploymentJobStatus
DescribeDeploymentJobStatus.summary: Queries the execution status summary of a certificate deployment task, including the number of succeeded and failed workers.

DescribePackageState.title: DescribePackageState
DescribePackageState.summary: Queries the quota and usage of domain validated (DV) certificate packages.

DescribeWarehouseCert.title: DescribeWarehouseCert
DescribeWarehouseCert.summary: Retrieves the details of a certificate stored in a certificate warehouse.

Encrypt.title: Encrypt
Encrypt.summary: Encrypts data by using a certificate in a certificate application repository.

GetCertWarehouseQuota.title: GetCertWarehouseQuota
GetCertWarehouseQuota.summary: Queries the remaining quota for certificate application repository operations.

GetCertificateDetail.title: Retrieve certificate details excluding private key
GetCertificateDetail.summary: Queries the details of a certificate without returning the certificate content or private key content.

GetCertificatePackageCount.title: Retrieve certificate resource plan quantity
GetCertificatePackageCount.summary: Retrieves the number of certificate resource plans.

GetCompany.title: Get certificate company or organization details
GetCompany.summary: Retrieves the details of a company.

GetCsrDetail.title: GetCsrDetail
GetCsrDetail.summary: Queries the content of a certificate signing request (CSR).

GetInstanceDetail.title: Query instance details
GetInstanceDetail.summary: Queries the details of an instance.

GetInstanceSummary.title: GetInstanceSummary
GetInstanceSummary.summary: Queries the summary statistics of Certificate Management Service instances, such as certificate counts by status.

GetMatchedResources.title: Retrieve matched resources for a certificate
GetMatchedResources.summary: Retrieves the resources that match a certificate.

GetRiskCount.title: GetRiskCount
GetRiskCount.summary: Queries the number of assets with certificate-related risks, such as expired or soon-to-expire certificates.

GetTaskAttribute.title: GetTaskAttribute
GetTaskAttribute.summary: Queries the processing result and status of a submitted certificate application.

GetUserCertificateDetail.title: Get certificate details
GetUserCertificateDetail.summary: Retrieves the details of a certificate, including basic information and public/private key content. You can use this operation to download the certificate content and private key.

ListAssetCount.title: Query cloud service resource statistics
ListAssetCount.summary: Queries the resource statistics list of cloud services.

ListCert.title: ListCert
ListCert.summary: This API queries certificates in the certificate store.

ListCertWarehouse.title: Query certificate repository list
ListCertWarehouse.summary: Queries the list of certificate repositories.

ListCertificates.title: ListCertificates
ListCertificates.summary: Queries the certificates managed by Certificate Management Service.

ListCloudAccess.title: ListCloudAccess
ListCloudAccess.summary: Queries the AccessKey pairs that are configured for multi-cloud certificate deployment.

ListCloudResources.title: ListCloudResources
ListCloudResources.summary: Queries the cloud resources on which certificates are deployed, such as Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances and CDN domains.

ListCsr.title: ListCsr
ListCsr.summary: Queries the certificate signing requests (CSRs) in your account.

ListDeploymentJob.title: Query deployment task list
ListDeploymentJob.summary: Retrieves a list of deployment tasks after you create a deployment task.

ListDeploymentJobCert.title: ListDeploymentJobCert
ListDeploymentJobCert.summary: Queries the certificates associated with a deployment task, such as the certificate instance ID, type, and name.

ListDeploymentJobResource.title: ListDeploymentJobResource
ListDeploymentJobResource.summary: Queries the cloud resources associated with a deployment task. An empty list indicates that the resources are invalid and must be re-associated.

ListTagKeys.title: Query tag keys
ListTagKeys.summary: Retrieves a list of tag keys and values.

ListTagResources.title: Get resource tag list
ListTagResources.summary: Retrieves the tags associated with a resource.

ListTrusteeOrder.title: Get managed order list
ListTrusteeOrder.summary: Retrieves the list of managed orders.

ListUserCertificateOrder.title: Query user certificates or orders
ListUserCertificateOrder.summary: Queries the list of user certificates or orders.

ListWorkerResource.title: ListWorkerResource
ListWorkerResource.summary: Queries the worker tasks of a deployment task. Each worker task deploys a certificate to a specific cloud resource in a cloud service.

MoveResourceGroup.title: MoveResourceGroup
MoveResourceGroup.summary: Changes the resource group to which a certificate or certificate order belongs.

RenewCertificateOrderForPackageRequest.title: RenewCertificateOrderForPackageRequest
RenewCertificateOrderForPackageRequest.summary: Submits a renewal application for an issued SSL certificate.

RevokeWHClientCertificate.title: RevokeWHClientCertificate
RevokeWHClientCertificate.summary: Revokes a client certificate from the certificate repository.

Sign.title: Sign
Sign.summary: This operation creates a digital signature with a PCA certificate from a certificate repository.

TagResources.title: Attach tags to a specified resource (SSL certificate instance)

UntagResources.title: Remove tags from a specified resource (SSL certificate instance)

UpdateCsr.title: Upload or update a CSR private key
UpdateCsr.summary: Uploads the private key corresponding to a CSR if you did not provide the CSR private key when uploading the local CSR.

UpdateDeploymentJob.title: UpdateDeploymentJob
UpdateDeploymentJob.summary: Updates the configuration of a certificate deployment task, such as the certificates or target resources.

UpdateDeploymentJobStatus.title: UpdateDeploymentJobStatus
UpdateDeploymentJobStatus.summary: Updates the status of a certificate deployment task, such as changing from editing to pending execution.

UpdateWorkerResourceStatus.title: Update worker task status in a deployment task
UpdateWorkerResourceStatus.summary: Updates the status of a worker task in a deployment task.

UploadCsr.title: UploadCsr
UploadCsr.summary: Uploads an existing certificate signing request (CSR) to Certificate Management Service. After the upload, you can use the CSR to apply for certificates.

UploadPCACert.title: Upload a PCA certificate to a certificate repository
UploadPCACert.summary: Uploads a PCA certificate to a certificate repository.

UploadUserCertificate.title: Upload a certificate
UploadUserCertificate.summary: Uploads a certificate, including a standard Chinese national cryptographic (China SM) certificate or a non-China SM certificate.

Verify.title: Verify
Verify.summary: Verifies a data signature by using a private certificate in a certificate application repository.
